title: Embed-URL Lambda: registered and anonymous embedding
scenario: Tidewater Ask embeds Quick Sight dashboards: registered tenants with a namespace each and user-based RLS, anonymous tenants on capacity pricing with tag-based RLS. Write the Lambda behind GET /analytics/embed-url that mints the right URL for the caller and nothing more, using the pilot's support tickets as the failure list.
task: Validate AllowedDomains and SessionLifetimeInMinutes against the API rules at cold start
Build GenerateEmbedUrlForRegisteredUser / ForAnonymousUser requests scoped by the tenant claim
Map Quick Sight errors to actionable HTTP responses; 503 with retry-after on throttling
no-store on every response; never log the URL
acceptance: Requests validate against the real Quick Sight model (Stubber) with exactly the tenant's scope
Query-string tenants, foreign dashboards and bad user names never widen access
Error mapping, headers and logging rules hold

practices.label: Week 6 Wed - registered vs anonymous embedding
Week 6 Thu - GenerateEmbedUrl, allowed domains, session lifecycle
